citations.quote: On September 29, 2010, FDA designated MOD-4023 as an orphan drug product for the treatment of growth hormone deficiency (GHD).

summary.text: Standard-review BLA under section 351(a) with Orphan Drug Designation for GHD. The original 2020 application received a Complete Response Letter (January 21, 2022) over immunogenicity and product quality; approval followed a November 22, 2022 resubmission and was granted June 27, 2023. Effectiveness was based on a single adequate and well-controlled phase 3 study (CP-4-006) plus confirmatory mechanistic evidence, acceptable because pediatric GHD is a rare disease.

citations.quote:
Application Type	BLA
Application Number(s)	761184
Priority or Standard	Standard

On November 30, 2020, Pfizer submitted a Biologics License Application (BLA) for somatrogon (also known as MOD-4023), a long-acting human growth hormone (hGH) derivative, under Section 351(a) of the Public Health Service Act with the following proposed indication: Treatment of pediatric subjects who have growth failure due to growth hormone deficiency.
Somatrogon has been granted Orphan Drug Designation (ODD) by the Office of Orphan Drug Products for the treatment of GHD.
A single adequate and well-controlled trial plus confirmatory evidence is acceptable for this BLA because pediatric GHD is a rare disease.
We acknowledge receipt of your resubmission dated November 22, 2022, which constituted a complete response to our January 21, 2022, action letter.
*Approval Date:* June 27, 2023
